name: Four Non Blondes
description: After a successful premiere in 2024 and international performances, Christoph Winkler's 'Four Non Blondes' returns to Berlin. This choreographic concert explores the cultural history and political significance of blonde hair through performance by four non-blonde performers and a singer, combining personal experiences, digital theatre elements and political narratives. The production examines blondness as symbol of youth, attractiveness, purity, whiteness, social aspiration, rebellion and self-determination across centuries. The piece uses trance, Eurodance and disco house to cast new light on the myth of blondness.
